item.title: Fixture check: refuse markup inside a redacted signature
item.body:
Refs #768 (part 1 only; part 2 is left, see below)
Claim: cloud/i768-sonnet

**Problem.** `anonymize.py check` accepted a redacted `span.signature` / `span.MoodStatus` holding an ``'<img … alt=…>'`` or a link around the placeholder, although `tooling/fixtures/README.md` says nothing else may remain.

**Cause.** `StructuralVerifier` only compared the span's text with the placeholder.

**Change.** In `StructuralVerifier.handle_starttag`, any element inside a signature/mood span other than `br` (no attributes) and one `div style="clear: both;"` is reported. It walks the verifier's own span stack and shares no selector with the redactor (LESSONS 33-34). README sentence added. No Swift code, no legacy-behaviour change.

**Tests.** `test_redacted_signature_allows_only_br_and_one_clear_div`: passes for placeholder, `br`, clear `div` shapes; fails for `img`, `a`, `b`, a plain `div`, a second clear `div`, `br` with attributes, and an `img` in a mood. Seen failing without the change (1 failure), 337 tests OK with it; corpus: 568 of 568 files clean.

**Left (needs the Mac):** part 2 of #768 (the handle in `R267a`'s prose, republishing from raw captures).
